name: Eugene Country Club (a parkland of giant firs and oaks in the Emerald City)
note: Course theme palette (<= 32 colours), same keys as pnw.json. Eugene Country Club, in the north of Eugene, the 'Emerald City' at the south end of the Willamette Valley (course chat, 2026-11-13). From the OSIP 2024 photo (fairway #728c69, green #91a16e, water #49616b): a deep emerald, slightly blue turf, long tree-lined corridors in shade; the bunker sand (shaded in the photo) drawn bright white, as the club's; ponds a dark slate. Trees: very tall Douglas fir and Oregon white oak, with bigleaf maple and the gold of Norway maples among them (trees_eugene_cc.py; a drawing choice, the lidar gives only crown shape). Shadows are a 35% black overlay on top of these.
